'''Star Tours Flight 208''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was stationed at Gate 2M, and its status was on time with an estimated time of arrival of 1150 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1245.
